rationale: Referencer extends eslint-scope's Referencer (an esrecurse Visitor); analyzeScope calls referencer.visit(ast), and the base Visitor dispatches this[node.type](node), so DeclareFunction runs for every Flow DeclareFunction node. The in-repo integration test 'support declarations #132' lints `declare function foo<T>(): void;` through babel-eslint-parser, exercising this path. The computed-key dispatch is inside the external esrecurse library, so no in-scope rule clearly targets it; dynamic-property-keyed-callback's obj[name]() pattern is a defensible secondary reading.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The two fp-novel verdicts correctly identify esrecurse's node.type dispatch. The tp verdict is wrong: Flow declarations are parsed and visited in the repo's own eslint integration tests.
